title: project-swarm 1.44.0: scaffold job --command, accept-blocked output exclusion, job worktrees outside the root + check-hit-swarm-dir, git-ignored-fixture existence check, max-output-below-model-default (T84, lessons 327–332)
head: swarm-1.44-batch-pr
body:
## What
- `scaffold job --command` adds the handler modules for a named swarm command to the scaffolded job's context; `validate` warns `command-handler-not-in-job` when a job prompt names a command whose handler is in neither its context nor its outputs.
- `integrate --accept-blocked` and `integrate --jobs` stop checking outputs of blocked or unselected jobs; a blocked job that wrote nothing adds no files and raises no refusals.
- Codex and Claude shell job worktrees are created outside the repository root; `ship` and `integrate` ignore check output lines whose paths begin with `.swarm/` when deciding pass/fail and report them once as a `check-hit-swarm-dir` warning with the count.
- `ship`'s preflight reports `git-ignored-fixture` only for a referenced path that both exists and is git-ignored; a path that only exists at runtime is never flagged, and `--exempt git-ignored-fixture:<file>=<reason>` still works.
- `validate` warns `max-output-below-model-default`, naming both values, when an API/OpenRouter job sets `maxOutputTokens` below its model default, which is 16000 for reasoning models.

## Mutation check
`swarm mutants --mutants-file docs/_swarm/t84-mutants.json` on the build tree: 5/5 killed, 0 survived. Lesson 330 ships narrowed (decision #345: check-output rule + `swarm-dir-not-ignored` warning; worktree relocation deferred to a T86 design brief).
- (a) handler check skipped → killed by tests/field-lessons-batch-ab-core.test.mjs
- (b) accept-blocked still checks the blocked job's outputs → killed by tests/field-lessons-batch-ab-core.test.mjs
- (c) .swarm/ lines not stripped → killed by tests/field-lessons-batch-ab-core.test.mjs
- (d) non-existent path still flagged → killed by tests/field-lessons-batch-ab-core.test.mjs
- (e) warning fires at the model default → killed by tests/field-lessons-batch-ab-core.test.mjs
